meta.title: DeepSeek chat
meta.description: A focused DeepSeek chat panel in the main area, opened from the DeepSeek chat entry in the left sidebar. Set your API key, model, thinking strength, and an optional location, and use Verify to check the key against the free /models endpoint before spending a completion. Chat with streaming Markdown replies: edit a user message to re-ask from it, continue a reply the service cut short, switch between regenerated answer versions, and read any answer aloud with an animated waveform while it plays. KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams render in answers (CDN-loaded, with source and code fallbacks), and a three-dot waiting state fills the gap before the first token. Drop, paste, or pick files: images and documents are uploaded through the DeepSeek Files API so the model reads them directly, no OCR step. Web search and link reading are server-side tools, so answers carry numbered citations, a page-count pill, a reasoning timeline, and a search drawer that lists every query, every result card, and every page the model read while the reply is still streaming. The microphone turns speech into text with recording and transcribing states. Settings can export and import conversations as a JSON backup that never includes the API key, or delete them all. Conversations, settings, and file ids stay in this browser's localStorage; requests go to your API base URL and uploaded files stay on the API service.
